{
  "source": "CHIJ St. Theresa's Convent Preliminary Examination 2022 Mathematics Paper 1 & Paper 2 (4048/01 & 4048/02)",
  "notes": "Word-only items only. Diagram, graph, construction, sketch and scale-drawing questions omitted. Answers from the separate marking-scheme PDFs; notation cleaned for bulk import. Spot-check Q4 (P1 currency) and Q10a (indices) against the papers before seeding.",
  "questions": [
    {
      "topic_code": "t04",
      "difficulty": "Easy",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Expansion and simplification",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q1",
      "prompt": "Simplify 2(5a + 3b) - 3(a - 2b).",
      "model_answer": "7a + 12b",
      "explanation": "2(5a + 3b) - 3(a - 2b) = 10a + 6b - 3a + 6b = 7a + 12b."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t04",
      "difficulty": "Easy",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Quadratic factorisation",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q2a",
      "prompt": "Factorise completely:\n\n2x^2 + 5x - 3.",
      "model_answer": "(2x - 1)(x + 3)",
      "explanation": "2x^2 + 5x - 3 = (2x - 1)(x + 3)."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t04",
      "difficulty": "Medium",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Factorisation by grouping",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q2b",
      "prompt": "Factorise completely:\n\n3ax + 6ay - x - 2y.",
      "model_answer": "(x + 2y)(3a - 1)",
      "explanation": "3ax + 6ay - x - 2y = 3a(x + 2y) - (x + 2y) = (x + 2y)(3a - 1)."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t03",
      "difficulty": "Medium",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Profit and loss",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q3",
      "prompt": "If Abigail sells a bicycle for $270, she would make a loss of 25%.\n\nHow much must she sell the bicycle for to make a profit of 40%?",
      "model_answer": "$504",
      "explanation": "75% of cost price = $270, so cost price = $360.\n140% of cost price = 1.4 x 360 = $504."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t03",
      "difficulty": "Medium",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Currency exchange",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q4",
      "prompt": "Cerra changed S$500 to US dollars in January at a rate of S$1 = USD 0.753.\nIn October, she changed the US dollars back to Singapore dollars at a rate of S$1 = USD 0.722.\n\nFind the difference in the amount of Singapore dollars she received. Give your answer correct to the nearest cent.",
      "model_answer": "S$21.47",
      "explanation": "USD received = 500 x 0.753 = USD 376.50.\nS$ on return = 376.50 / 0.722 = S$521.47 (nearest cent).\nDifference = 521.47 - 500 = S$21.47."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t06",
      "difficulty": "Medium",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Linear equations with fractions",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q6a",
      "prompt": "Solve the equation\n\nx/3 - (2x - 5)/2 = 1.",
      "model_answer": "x = 9/4",
      "explanation": "Multiply by 6: 2x - 3(2x - 5) = 6.\n2x - 6x + 15 = 6.\n-4x = -9, so x = 9/4."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t04",
      "difficulty": "Easy",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Substitution",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q6bi",
      "prompt": "Given that q = 25 - 2p^2, find q when p = -3.",
      "model_answer": "7",
      "explanation": "q = 25 - 2(-3)^2 = 25 - 18 = 7."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t04",
      "difficulty": "Medium",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Changing the subject",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q6bii",
      "prompt": "Given that q = 25 - 2p^2, rearrange the formula to make p the subject.",
      "model_answer": "p = +/- sqrt((25 - q)/2)",
      "explanation": "2p^2 = 25 - q.\np^2 = (25 - q)/2.\np = +/- sqrt((25 - q)/2)."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t04",
      "difficulty": "Hard",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Algebraic identities",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q7",
      "prompt": "Given that x - y = 7 and xy = 18, find the values of x^2 - y^2.",
      "model_answer": "77 or -77",
      "explanation": "x^2 - y^2 = (x - y)(x + y) = 7(x + y).\n(x + y)^2 = (x - y)^2 + 4xy = 49 + 72 = 121.\nx + y = 11 or -11.\nSo x^2 - y^2 = 77 or -77."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t04",
      "difficulty": "Medium",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Algebraic fractions",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q10a",
      "prompt": "Simplify\n\n(6x^3 / 5y^2) / (14xy^3 / 15).",
      "model_answer": "9x^2 / (7y^5)",
      "explanation": "(6x^3/5y^2) x (15/14xy^3) = 90x^3 / (70xy^5) = 9x^2 / (7y^5)."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t04",
      "difficulty": "Medium",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Indices",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q10b",
      "prompt": "4^k = 1/4^9 + 1/4^9 + 1/4^9 + 1/4^9.\n\nWithout the use of a calculator, find the value of k.",
      "model_answer": "-8",
      "explanation": "RHS = 4 x (1/4^9) = 4/4^9 = 4^(1-9) = 4^(-8).\nSo k = -8."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t16",
      "difficulty": "Medium",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Mode and median",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q11",
      "prompt": "The values of seven numbers are (x - 3), (x + 3), (x - 4), (x + 7), (x + 4), (x - 3), (x + 2).\n\nFind the value of x if the sum of the mode and the median of the numbers is 17.",
      "model_answer": "9",
      "explanation": "Ordered: (x-4), (x-3), (x-3), (x+2), (x+3), (x+4), (x+7).\nMode = x - 3, median = x + 2.\n(x - 3) + (x + 2) = 17.\n2x - 1 = 17, so x = 9."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t02",
      "difficulty": "Easy",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Map scales",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q12a",
      "prompt": "A map has a scale of 1 : 50 000.\n\nThe distance from Jurong to Changi is 26 km. Calculate the distance, in centimetres, between Jurong and Changi on the map.",
      "model_answer": "52 cm",
      "explanation": "1 cm on map = 50 000 cm = 0.5 km.\n26 km is represented by 26 / 0.5 = 52 cm."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t02",
      "difficulty": "Medium",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Map scales",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q12b",
      "prompt": "A map has a scale of 1 : 50 000.\n\nThe East Coast Park has an area of 1.85 km^2. Calculate the area, in square centimetres, of East Coast Park on the map.",
      "model_answer": "74 cm^2",
      "explanation": "1 cm on the map represents 0.5 km, so 1 cm^2 represents 0.25 km^2.\nArea on map = 1.85 / 0.25 = 7.4 cm^2.\nMarking scheme gives 74 cm^2 — spot-check the paper scale wording before seeding."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t05",
      "difficulty": "Easy",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Quadratic graphs",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q14a",
      "prompt": "The graph of y = (x + a)(2 - x) cuts the y-axis at R(0, 14).\n\nFind the value of a.",

    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t05",
      "difficulty": "Easy",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Line of symmetry",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q14b",
      "prompt": "For y = (x + 7)(2 - x), state the equation of the line of symmetry.",
      "model_answer": "x = -2.5",
      "explanation": "Roots are x = -7 and x = 2.\nAxis of symmetry: x = (-7 + 2)/2 = -2.5."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t04",
      "difficulty": "Medium",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Completing the square",

      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q15a",
      "prompt": "Express x^2 - 6x + 11 in the form (x - h)^2 + k.",

    {
      "topic_code": "t01",

      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Prime factorisation",

      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q16a",

      "explanation": "35 000 = 35 x 1000 = 5 x 7 x 10^3 = 2^3 x 5^3 x 7."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t01",

      "subtopic": "LCM and prime factors",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q16bi",

    {
      "topic_code": "t01",

      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q16bii",
      "prompt": "P = 2^4 x 5^3 x 7 and Q = 2 x 5^3 x 7.\n\nFind the highest common factor (HCF) of P and Q.",

    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t03",
      "difficulty": "Hard",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Compound interest",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q17",
      "prompt": "Eunice bought a 3-Room HDB apartment for $120 000. She paid 15% downpayment and took a loan on the outstanding balance for 10 years at r% per annum compounded annually. Her monthly instalment was $1270.\n\nCalculate r.",
      "model_answer": "4.10%",
      "explanation": "Loan = 0.85 x 120 000 = $102 000.\nTotal paid = 1270 x 12 x 10 = $152 400.\n152 400 = 102 000(1 + r/100)^10.\n(1 + r/100)^10 = 152400/102000 = 127/85.\nr ≈ 4.10%."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t01",
      "difficulty": "Easy",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Arithmetic sequences",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q19a",
      "prompt": "In a sequence, the same number is subtracted each time to obtain the next term. The first five terms are 17, p, q, r, 7.\n\nFind the value of r.",
      "model_answer": "-1",
      "explanation": "Common difference d = -6 (from T_n = -6n + 23).\nFourth term r = 17 + 3(-6) = -1."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t01",
      "difficulty": "Easy",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "nth term",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q19b",
      "prompt": "An arithmetic sequence has first term 17 and common difference -6.\n\nFind an expression, in terms of n, for the nth term.",
      "model_answer": "-6n + 23",
      "explanation": "T_n = 17 + (n - 1)(-6) = 17 - 6n + 6 = -6n + 23."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t01",
      "difficulty": "Medium",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "nth term",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q19c",
      "prompt": "The nth term of a sequence is -6n + 23.\n\nExplain why -345 is not a term of this sequence.",
      "model_answer": "-345 is not a term because n would not be an integer.",

    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t17",
      "difficulty": "Easy",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Simple probability",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q20a",
      "prompt": "A box contains 5 red marbles and 3 green marbles. One marble is chosen at random. Find the probability of obtaining a green marble.",
      "model_answer": "3/8",
      "explanation": "P(green) = 3/(5 + 3) = 3/8."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t17",
      "difficulty": "Easy",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Simple probability",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q20b",
      "prompt": "A fair 6-sided die is rolled. Find the probability of obtaining a prime number.",

      "explanation": "Prime outcomes: 2, 3, 5 — three out of six.\nP = 3/6 = 1/2."

      "difficulty": "Easy",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Simple probability",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p1,q20c",
      "prompt": "A number is selected at random from {3, 5, 7, 9}. Find the probability of obtaining an even number.",
      "model_answer": "0",

    {
      "topic_code": "t04",
      "difficulty": "Medium",

      "subtopic": "Indices",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p2,q1a",
      "prompt": "Simplify (32a^10 / b^15)^(-2/5).",

      "explanation": "(32a^10/b^15)^(-2/5) = (b^15/32a^10)^(2/5) = b^6 / (4a^4)."

    {

      "tags": "stc-2022-p2,q1b",
      "prompt": "Express y/(3y - 5)^2 + 2/(5 - 3y) as a single fraction in its simplest form.",

      "explanation": "2/(5 - 3y) = -2/(3y - 5).\ny/(3y - 5)^2 - 2/(3y - 5) = [y - 2(3y - 5)] / (3y - 5)^2 = (10 - 5y) / (3y - 5)^2."
    },
    {
      "topic_code": "t04",
      "difficulty": "Medium",

      "tags": "stc-2022-p2,q2a",
      "prompt": "A bag contains 10 red balls and 8 green balls. Anna takes two balls at random without replacement. She claims P(one red and one green) = 2/9.\n\nExplain why she is wrong and find the correct probability.",
      "model_answer": "80/153 (she ignored that the draws are without replacement)",

    {

      "difficulty": "Hard",
      "diagram_required": false,
      "subtopic": "Probability forming equations",
      "question_type": "open",
      "tags": "stc-2022-p2,q2b",
      "prompt": "A bag has 10 red and 8 green balls. n red balls are removed. Two balls are then drawn without replacement. P(both green) = 4/13.\n\nShow that n^2 - 35n + 124 = 0.",

      "difficulty": "Medium",
      "diagram_required": false,

      "tags": "stc-2022-p2,q2d",
      "prompt": "When solving n^2 - 35n + 124 = 0 for the number of red balls removed from a bag that originally had only 10 red balls, explain why one solution must be rejected.",

Carol buys 5 Latte, 4 Mocha.\n\nRepresent their purchases in a 3 x 2 matrix Q (rows: drink types A, L, M; columns: Belinda, Carol).",
